defects.title: Server progress hydrate replaced local completedSubSteps/bookmarks wholesale
defects.repro: Local learner has completedSubSteps for setup; hydrateFromServer({progress:{}, bookmarks:[]}) replaced maps with empty server data.
hypotheses: hydrateFromServer intentionally treats server as source of truth (rejected: loses offline work)
hydrateFromServer was written assuming server always has superset of local (unsupported)
Missing merge union on multi-device/offline scenarios (accepted)
defects.root_cause: set({ completedSubSteps: data.progress || {}, bookmarks: data.bookmarks || [] }) overwrote local progress without merge.
analogous_patterns: Any future cloud sync for quizScores/completedSections must use the same merge helpers
defects.fix: src/lib/progress-sanitize.ts mergeServerProgress + progress-store hydrateFromServer uses merge

defects.title: Playwright zero-retry suite used trace on-first-retry
defects.root_cause: retries:0 means on-first-retry never captures traces

defects.title: static_public E2E used conditional try/catch that could pass without verifying language toggle or section open
defects.fix: scripts/static_public.spec.ts strengthened assertions + removed waitForTimeout sleeps
